description: This file defines command registry functions for a chat or command interface, including command parsing, normalization, detection, and resolution, with external dependencies on configuration, channel plugins, and command data.

methods.name: getTextAliasMap
methods.description: Builds and caches a map of text aliases to command specifications.

methods.name: buildSkillCommandDefinitions
methods.description: Creates command definitions from skill command specifications.

methods.name: listChatCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of chat commands, optionally including skill commands.

methods.name: isCommandEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a command is enabled based on configuration flags.

methods.name: listChatCommandsForConfig
methods.description: Returns chat commands enabled under a specific configuration, including skill commands.

methods.name: resolveNativeName
methods.description: Resolves the native name of a command, possibly using a channel plugin.

methods.name: toNativeCommandSpec
methods.description: Converts a chat command definition to a native command specification.

methods.name: listNativeSpecsFromCommands
methods.description: Generates native command specs from a list of chat commands.

methods.name: listNativeCommandSpecs
methods.description: Lists native command specifications, optionally for specific skill commands and provider.

methods.name: listNativeCommandSpecsForConfig
methods.description: Lists native command specs for a given configuration and optional skill commands.

methods.name: findCommandByNativeName
methods.description: Finds a command definition by its native name and provider.

methods.name: buildCommandText
methods.description: Constructs command text with optional arguments.

methods.name: parsePositionalArgs
methods.description: Parses positional command arguments from raw input.

methods.name: formatPositionalArgs
methods.description: Formats command argument values into a string.

methods.name: parseCommandArgs
methods.description: Parses command arguments from raw input based on command definition.

methods.name: serializeCommandArgs
methods.description: Serializes command arguments into a string.

methods.name: buildCommandTextFromArgs
methods.description: Builds full command text from command definition and arguments.

methods.name: resolveDefaultCommandContext
methods.description: Resolves default provider and model context for commands.

methods.name: resolveCommandArgChoices
methods.description: Resolves choices for command arguments, possibly dynamically.

methods.name: resolveCommandArgMenu
methods.description: Resolves argument menu choices for commands.

methods.name: normalizeCommandBody
methods.description: Normalizes command input text, handling aliases and formatting.

methods.name: isCommandMessage
methods.description: Checks if a raw message is a command message.

methods.name: getCommandDetection
methods.description: Generates detection patterns for commands.

methods.name: maybeResolveTextAlias
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a text alias to a command key.

methods.name: resolveTextCommand
methods.description: Resolves a raw text command into command definition and arguments.

methods.name: isNativeCommandSurface
methods.description: Checks if a surface is a native command surface.

methods.name: shouldHandleTextCommands
methods.description: Determines if text commands should be handled based on context and configuration.
